senses.sense_definition: A young human being below the age of puberty or below the legal age of majority.

examples.text: The small <w>child</w> played happily in the sandbox.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Молодой человек, не достигший половой зрелости или совершеннолетия.

target_lang_definitions.de: Ein junger Mensch vor Erreichen der Pubertät oder der gesetzlichen Volljährigkeit.

target_lang_definitions.it: Un essere umano giovane al di sotto dell'età della pubertà o della maggiore età legale.

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing strongly influenced by a specific time, place, or set of circumstances.
